text: We run a community event for researchers and would like to discuss having you present a demonstration.
My card statement has two completed charges for this month, but I only have one subscription. Please reverse the extra payment.
We need a way to export translation keys for a translator and import the completed translations later.
Our research group is interested in a joint workshop on collecting better labelled data. Who handles partnerships?
I know CSV download works. What we need is a new automatic export into our warehouse every night.
I retried checkout after a timeout. Both payments have now settled and I need one of them returned.
We no longer need the unused seats we paid for yesterday. Is a refund possible under your policy?
I can enter my password, but the login screen keeps sending me back to itself.
Would someone from your team be available for an interview about the product for our newsletter?
I am using the existing Excel export option. It produces a corrupted workbook instead of the file we received last week.
Please turn off automatic renewal at the end of our current paid term. We still need access until then.
Please remove my optional contact details from the response I submitted. I do not want to change the answer itself.
Could you add a direct integration with our issue tracker so each accepted response can create a ticket?
Can you confirm whether my refund was issued? The credit has not appeared on my statement yet.
How can I use the existing optional email field? I am looking for setup instructions rather than a new feature.
The download stops halfway through and leaves a file that will not open. A small campaign exports successfully.
The notification badge stays on after I read every item. Refreshing and signing back in do not clear it.
There is no calendar connector in the current integration list. We would like one for scheduling follow-up interviews.
There is currently no bulk reviewer assignment. We need to allocate batches without opening each response.
Please add a bulk rename tool for imported question titles, with a preview before applying changes.
Our university is exploring a collaboration on annotation practices. Can you connect us with the right person?
Clicking Download CSV spins for a while and then reports an error. The results are visible on screen.
Could contributors choose the language of the questionnaire from a selector? We currently have to create separate campaigns.
Our team uses a different storage provider from the supported ones. Is a native connector for it something you could build?
Our security review asks which service providers process account information. Where is the current list?
What does the validation split mean in the dataset manifest? I would appreciate an explanation of the terminology.
The export finishes, but the downloaded file is empty even though this campaign has responses.
Would you add an owner-side preview for switching between language versions without changing the published campaign?
Could we edit the response deadline across multiple campaigns in a single operation?
My subscription is paid and active. I need help with the sign-in failure, not a billing change.
I can still sign in after cancelling. Can billing confirm that this is access for the remaining paid period and that no further payment is scheduled?
I would like a select-all action for applying the same tag to many responses.
We would like to copy the same introduction into several new drafts at once. This is not available in the current editor.
Who should we contact to discuss a data retention requirement before starting a research project?
Would you support a new automation trigger when a reviewer changes a label? The existing trigger only fires for new answers.
Could we discuss a co-authored tutorial using public fictional data? This is an editorial enquiry, not a support issue.
Could you move us back to the free plan when this billing period finishes?
Some columns vanish from the CSV even though those fields have answers in the results view. Can you investigate?
We would like translated button labels. The current fixed English labels make our Spanish campaign inconsistent.
I would like a copy of the personal information associated with my account.
Can you add a way to archive several campaigns at once? Opening each one individually takes a long time.
Since this morning, signing in returns a server error before I reach the dashboard. My colleague sees it too.
Where do I find the contributor link after publishing? I am setting up my first campaign.
The editor only lets me duplicate one question at a time. Please add duplication of a selected group.
I want to cancel the subscription, not delete the data in my account. What do I need to do?
We merged two workspaces and only need one subscription now. Please end the renewal on the old workspace.
I need to understand the procedure for a contributor withdrawing their data. Could you send the relevant policy?
Every new response now sends the same notification three times. It used to send only one.
The daily digest reports zero responses while the results page shows new submissions for that same day.
Please return the payment for my latest renewal. I have not used the service since it renewed.
I understand the export issue is being investigated separately. My request here is reimbursement for the period we could not use the account.
Please allow a different completion message for each language in the same campaign.
Email alerts go to the previous recipient even after I save the replacement address and reload settings.
The verification code arrives immediately, but the form calls it expired even when I paste it straight away.
I switched off daily summaries, saved the setting and checked it again. The emails are still arriving.
Single sign-on worked yesterday. Today the redirect returns to an error page saying the session could not be created.
We would like permission to use a screenshot of your public website in a conference presentation.
After signing in on mobile, I am logged out as soon as I open a campaign. This happens in two browsers.
The export link created a minute ago says the file is missing. Generating a second export gives the same result.
I bought the wrong subscription for our project. Before I purchase the right one, please explain the refund process for this order.
The trial converted to a paid subscription before I expected. I would like the charge reviewed for a refund.
Who manages educational partnerships? We want to explore using the product in a methods course.
JSON exports used to work for this project. Now the download returns a server error every time.
Our existing webhook delivery suddenly returns errors. The destination is reachable and the connection worked yesterday.
I am writing a directory entry and want to confirm the company description before publishing it.
We currently copy results into our CRM by hand because this CRM has no connector. Can you add one?
Our finance team matched the renewal invoice to two bank transactions. We need the excess payment reimbursed, not another account.
Password reset says it succeeded. The new password is still rejected when I try to log in.
Where are the servers that store campaign responses located?
Please add a right-to-left layout option for questionnaires written in Arabic.
Individual deletions work. The missing capability is deleting a selected batch after one confirmation.
Please consider adding a chat notification destination alongside the email alerts you already support.
The current language settings work. I am requesting an additional locale that is not in the supported list.
The plan is working fine. This ticket is just about the extra renewal charge on my card; please remove it.
The app works well, but the budget has been cut. I need to arrange cancellation before the annual renewal.
The sign-in link opens a blank page. I requested a fresh one twice and both links fail in the same way.
The notification link points to a page that says campaign not found, even though the campaign still exists.
The payment screen froze so I clicked again. I now see two settled debits. Please help me recover the duplicate amount.
The file contains only the header row. I selected all responses and the table shows forty entries.
Please explain how long contributor responses are retained after a campaign closes.
Could the date input support a configurable local format? At the moment only the default format is available.
Could you explain the difference between an owner link and a reviewer link?
I have not tried the export yet. Which of the existing formats should I choose for opening answers in a spreadsheet?
Cancel my paid membership please. I do not want another charge next month.
We moved from monthly to annual billing yesterday. The annual payment is correct, but a second monthly payment was taken as well. Please credit that extra charge.
The current integration works as documented. I would like it extended to include review decisions as well as raw responses.
Your colleague agreed to refund last week's charge. Could billing check its status and provide the refund reference?
Can you direct our privacy team to your data processing agreement?
I purchased the yearly plan by mistake this morning. Can you refund it so I can choose monthly instead?
Could you point me to the documentation for pausing a live campaign?
Paid once. Charged twice. Can someone refund the second transaction?
Is there a guide to writing a useful classification rubric for a collection campaign?
How do I preview a campaign before I approve it? Nothing is broken; I just cannot find the instructions.
There are two identical subscription debits dated Monday. Neither is marked pending by the bank. Could you investigate the duplicate?
Response notifications are enabled, but no emails have arrived since Tuesday. New answers are appearing in the dashboard.
Our project ends this month. Can you stop the next invoice and confirm the final access date?
